name: Douala
description: The economic capital: busy port, markets, nightlife and great grilled fish.

name: Yaoundé
description: The political capital, built on seven hills, with museums and lively neighborhoods.

name: Kribi
description: Palm-lined beaches, the Lobé waterfalls falling into the ocean and fresh seafood.

name: Limbe
description: Black volcanic sand beaches, a botanical garden and a wildlife centre.

name: Buea
description: Starting point for climbing Mount Cameroon, the highest peak in the country.

name: Bafoussam
description: Gateway to the Grassfields, with rich Bamiléké culture and cool green hills.

name: Foumban
description: Home of the Sultan's palace, the royal museum and famous Bamoun crafts.

name: Dschang
description: A cool mountain town with waterfalls, a scenic lake and coffee-growing hills.

name: Bamenda
description: Highland city known for its climate, craft markets and traditional chiefdoms.

name: Maroua
description: A Sahelian city of leather craft, colorful markets and the road to Waza National Park.

name: Garoua
description: Port city on the Bénoué river, gateway to Bouba Ndjida and Faro national parks.

name: Ngaoundéré
description: High-plateau city with cool weather, famous grilled beef (soya) and the railway terminus.
